items.body:
Context : git localized in french, gitea running normally. 
`tea clone [my repo] `
fails with error 
`Error: git rev-parse --show-toplevel: fatal: ni ceci ni aucun de ses répertoires parents n'est un dépôt git : .git`
..meanwhile 
`LANG=en_GB LC_ALL=en_GB LANGUAGE=en_GB tea clone [my repo]`
works as appropriate. 
I can't confirm the fix, but the analysis and the diff look good. 
Since pretty much any work starts with a tea clone, this bug prevents any non-english localized git user to start working right away...
